dogecoin.text:
#Dogecoin developers have released a new version of the protocol's core with faster synchronization speed. The new core also cut the default time transactions are cashed in - from 336 to 24 hours. Besides, the speed of block uploading is now +3.84% faster.

#DOGE @dogecoin
🎙️ @Poloniex crypto exchange is launching $DOGE and $DOT Futures on Mar 18. $200 USDT will be shared among 10 random users before it ends on Mar 19.

This Friday @cryptocom will reportedly launch its #NFT platform, allowing to purchase/trade #NFTs using 23 kinds of cryptos, $BTC, $ETH and $DOGE among them. All users who have NFT marketplace accounts will  be able to participate.

Latvian @airBaltic has started accepting payment with #Ether ($ETH) and #Dogecoin ($DOGE). Airline passengers have been making crypto payments since 2014. The company has already sold tickets for $BCH, $USDC, $BUSD, $GUSD and $PAX.

.@ElonMusk's tweets keep sending #Dogecoin to the stratosphere, now with a market capitalization over $8 billion. 
Musk's tweet was enough to rise the cryptocurrency from $0.053 to $0.070 (+32%). 
https://t.co/JoWvLrAV5O

According to Coingecko, $DOGE hit new all-time-high about 20 minutes ago, reaching $0.549998. As of now, DOGE is trading at $0.586754 with 46.6% 24h-growth. Dogecoin’s market cap also peaked today, accounting for $76B. 📈

. @Gemini Exchange has added @dogecoin, as well as @SushiSwap, @InjectiveLabs, and @0xPolygon to its Earn lending program. Now exchange users can use 32 cryptocurrencies to receive interest on their assets
. @elonmusk has posted a poll to find out if people want @Tesla to accept @dogecoin. Most people have voted affirmative.

Social media users criticized @binance, and its CEO @cz_binance after listing @Shibtoken on their platform. People believe that the @dogecoin's doppelganger becomes the killer of the first meme coin. Zhao replied that they were only meeting the high demand for #ShibaInu.

. @VitalikButerin doesn't agree with @elonmusk on the superiority of @dogecoin. #Buterin wrote about the need for a compromise between decentralization and scalability when building blockchain networks and wrote a big article about it. Musk has already responded to this.

American convenience store chain @sheetz announced that it will start accepting #crypto as payment in the retail outlets. The company has partnered with the digital payment provider @FlexaHQ to implement this. Buyers can pay for their good and gas with $BTC, $ETH, $LTC and $DOGE.

. @dogecoin is growing on the background of the listing on @CoinbasePro, which will happen today. Users can already transfer the coins to their exchange wallets. Over the past day, #DOGE has grown by 34% and now its price is $0.42.

. @Coinbase has announced that it will be giving away $1.2M in $DOGE tokens in the coming months to draw attention to the coin's recent listing. Exchange users who buy or sell $100 in #DOGE by June 2021 can participate in and receive a prize of either $300k, $30k or $100.

Billy Marcus, co-founder of @dogecoin, sells a line of $DOGE inspired NFTs. The cryptocurrency now has its own #NFT collection, 420 of which are available for purchase. All NFTs appear to be a version of the same spinning coin with the #Dogecoin logo printed on it.
